note: Curated evidence may contain a blank line, the same separator a state uses between its provenance elements (#1680). Register TEST (1, variant 2) has editions 2018 and 2020; Q (var 5) is documented only in 2018 and an [[errata.delivered]] entry adds it to 2020 with evidence "accepted\n\ndelivery". The 2020 state carries that evidence verbatim, and the delivery-coverage check finds the entry's whole provenance as one element of the state's provenance, so the build reports no issue.
fails_if: `catalog_dependencies.check_delivery_coverage` splits the written state provenance on blank lines to find a claimed attribution, so evidence with a blank line is reported as a missing attribution (`unexplained_delivery_fact_change` on v5 people/Q 2020)

sources.description: Editions 2018 and 2020; Q documented only in 2018.
